ModMetaData.name: Rimefeller Compat Patch
ModMetaData.author: KahirDragoon
ModMetaData.description:
Automatically patches all by chemfuel refuellable Things to be compatible with Rimefeller. Also connects Neutroamine Refinery to the Neutroamine PipeNetwork from Androids.
Patches added for - Bioreactor - VFE Chemfuel - VFE Androids - Vanilla Expanded Gravship Chapter 1 - VFE Mechanoids (1.4, 1.5 only) - VFE Ancients (1.4, 1.5 only)
Safe to add midgame. Removal will result in harmless one time erros.
